title: New here. Whats the guide on making 3d assets and putting them into a game? Ive been just doing pixel games cause i dont know
author: BloodMossHunter
selftext: And is 20$ plan gonna be enough? Im curious if i could remake my nba game w 3d models have better animations than the iso game i made

comments.author: r0b0c0p87
comments.body: You can download a free program called Blender. It has an MCP server your ai can hook into to create 3d assets for you. There are a lot of tutorials on Youtube, but I think they tend to make it look easier than it really is. I have yet to get very good results.
